location.street_scene: Operational fixed golden triple-chevron at pale-green masonry facade with many blue shutters and patterned windows. A hard-hat worker stands just to left. Blue Lumi Cab taxi in cross-street farther left. Owner photo alone does not show name Sommi.
location.player_directions: Starting at Rouge Plaza, travel to its WESTERN edge, leave the circular road, and find the blue-shuttered building on the west/northwest side. The permanent gold Holovator stands beside a worker in a white hard hat; use it to reach the adjacent broad tiled rooftop. On an earlier save it may be red until completing Side Mission 004's battle with Sommi.
location.rooftop_exit_scene: Wide flat grey tiled roof, pitched slate-and-brick surrounding roofs, raised fenced rooftop garden/patio across neighbouring slope, pink Mega Crystals at right, distant high building with blue emblem. A Investigate prompt is not an item or reward proof.
